POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
L. S. 324
18/5/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
May 17th 1916.

Sir,
At 2 p.m. 14th instant some fifty Chinese held a meeting in the Palace Hotel to discuss the attitude which they should take up in connection with conference, which Feng Kuo Chang has proposed to hold in Nanking. Those present at the meeting included representatives of twenty two provinces. Tong Shao Yi 唐紹儀 acted as chairman and speeches were made by Tong Hua Lung 湯化龍 Tan Yion Kan 譚延闓 Chang Hsih 張錫 and others. As a result of the speeches and the discussion which followed it was decided to send a letter to Feng Kuo Chang 馮國璋 signed by the provincial representatives. The letter refers to the treason of the President in trying to make himself Emperor and goes on to say that nothing less than Yuan's retirement will solve the problems with which China is confronted at the present time. It suggests that Li Yuan Hung act temporarily as president after the abdication of Yuan Shih Kai. The letter also accuses the President of having caused the present financial crisis through collecting all available funds for his own private purposes. The meeting which was very orderly terminated at 6 p.m. The hall in which it took place was engaged by the Tsung Wha Sing Pao (中華新報).
There is no truth in the reports that the troops at Woosung are discontent because they receive their wages in notes on 12th inst. As a matter of fact they were paid in silver.
With regard to yesterday's report to the effect that General Yang had received instructions to dispense with the service of supernumeraries, the night workmen in the Arsenal were discharged yesterday.
The breach blocks have been replaced in most of the guns at Woosung.
It is reported that the rebels in Shanghai are prepared to promise Feng Kuo Chang not to cause further trouble in this province on the following condition:- All rebels at present in custody to be detained but not executed and no further arrests of rebels be made.
Ten armed soldiers arrived here from Nanking this morning and went to the Arsenal by way of Chapel and the Soochow Creek.

L. S. 324
18/5/16
上海工部局。
1916年5月17日。

先生：

本月14日下午2时，约五十名华人在礼查饭店（Palace Hotel）举行会议，讨论他们应对冯国璋提议在南京召开的会议所持的态度。出席会议者包括二十二个省的代表。唐绍仪担任主席，汤化龙、谭延闓、张锡等人发表了演说。经过演说及随后的讨论，决定由各省代表联名致函冯国璋。信中提及总统企图称帝之叛国行为，并指出除非袁世凯退位，否则无法解决中国目前面临的问题。信中还建议，在袁世凯退位后，由黎元洪暂时代理总统职务。信中还指责总统为了一己私利搜刮所有可用资金，从而导致了目前的财政危机。会议秩序井然，于下午6时结束。会场由《中华新报》租用。

关于吴淞驻军因本月12日以纸币发放薪饷而产生不满的传闻，纯属不实。事实上，他们是以银元领取薪饷的。

关于昨日报告中提及杨将军已接到指令裁减多余人员一事，兵工厂的夜间工人已于昨日被解雇。

吴淞大部分火炮的炮闩已更换完毕。

据报，上海的革命党人准备向冯国璋承诺不再在本省制造进一步麻烦，条件如下：目前被拘留的所有革命党人予以关押但不处决，且不再逮捕其他革命党人。

十名武装士兵今晨从南京抵达此处，经教堂路（Chapel Road）和苏州河前往兵工厂。

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
2
At about 11 p.m. on May 8th a steam launch which
came from the direction of Shanghai went close to the
Chinese gunboat Cha De 策電 anchored at Woosung.
Those on board the launch were challenged by the
gunboat but they failed to stop or give the countersign
and so they were fired at with rifles. The launch
then turned round and went Shanghai wards but
returned in about two minutes passing close to the gunboat
Hoo Wei 虎威. This gunboat also challenged and failing
to get a reply opened fire on the launch which in
turning came within range of the soldiers on shore
at the forts who also fired a number of shots. The launch
steamed away towards Shanghai and did not return.
The Chinese authorities regard this as an attempt
to effect a repetition of the incident which occurred
in the beginning of the month when six Japanese
were arrested whilst attempting to board from
a steam tug the gunboat Chia De 策電 and subsequently
handed over to their Consul by the Chinese Authorities.
Your Obedient Servant,
mmimiu amustraq
Chief Detective Inspector.
（批：kd 17/5）
（批：am 17/5）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
191
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）
2
5月8日晚11时许，一艘从上海方向驶来的蒸汽汽艇靠近停泊在吴淞的中国炮舰“策电”号。汽艇上的人员受到炮舰盘问，但他们未停船也未给出暗号，因此遭到步枪射击。汽艇随即掉头向上海方向驶去，但约两分钟后又返回，从另一艘炮舰“虎威”号附近经过。该炮舰也进行了盘问，因未得到回应而向汽艇开火；汽艇在转向时进入了岸上堡垒士兵的射程范围，这些士兵也发射了数枪。汽艇随后向上海方向驶离，未再返回。

中国当局认为，这是企图重演本月初发生的事件：当时六名日本人试图从一艘蒸汽拖轮登上“策电”号炮舰时被逮捕，随后由中国当局移交给其领事。

您顺从的仆人，
mmimiu amustraq
首席侦探督察。
（批注：kd 17/5）
（批注：am 17/5）
警察总监。

C. I. O.
E. O. REG
No. 234
Date 18/5/16

Eastern Times.
16-5-16,

After the newspapers had published the telegram
despatched by Feng Kuo Chang, the Chiangchun of
Kiangsu, to the authorities of the seventeen provinces
who are still loyal to the Central Government,
giving his opinion regarding the general situation
of China, the gentry and merchants of these provinces
elected prominent persons as their representatives.
These representatives held a meeting in the Palace
Hotel on the 14th instant. The meeting was opened
at 2 p.m. and closed at 6 p.m. Messrs Tang Shao Yi,
Tan Yi Kai 譚延闓 , Chang Chi 張繼 and Tong Hua
Loong 湯化龍 were present. They discussed the
telegram and decided to make an announcement for the
information of the public and address a letter to
Feng Kuo Chang.

（印：BRITISH LEGATION - S. M. P. SHANGHAI / H O / 16 MAY 1916）

首席督察办公室 (C. I. O.)
外事登记 (E. O. REG)
第 234 号
日期 18/5/16

《字林西报》(Eastern Times)。
1916年5月16日，

在各报纸刊登了江苏督军冯国璋发给仍效忠中央政府的十七省当局的电报后——该电报阐述了他对中国总体局势的看法——这些省份的绅商选举了知名人士作为他们的代表。这些代表于本月14日在礼查饭店举行会议。会议于下午2时开始，下午6时结束。唐绍仪、谭延闓、张继和汤化龙等先生出席了会议。他们讨论了该电报，决定发表公告以告知公众，并致函冯国璋。

（印章：英国公使馆 - 上海工部局警务处 / 内政部 / 1916年5月16日）
